messages:
Anika: kicking off the 2.3-int8 canary to 5% on staging. quick heads-up — summarization tests show a quality dip vs fp16 baseline. avg ROUGE-L -4.8%, mean token entropy +0.42. thinking we should gate on combined signal (semantic sim + entropy) rather than just latency. suggestions?
Miguel: can you paste the A/B breakdown by slice? overall numbers are noisy.
Anika: overall (n=10k): ROUGE-L delta -4.8, embed cosine delta -0.06. contracts/legal slice (n=1.2k): ROUGE-L -8.3, cosine -0.12. latency unchanged. :thinking_face:
Samir: that contracts delta is a red flag. proposal: hysteresis gating — require 2 consecutive 15-min windows breaching threshold to trigger fallback. prevents flapping. also add auto-alert to #incidents when contracts slice crosses -6%.
Rebecca: agree with hysteresis. define the gate like: primary gate = contracts_rouge_delta <= -5% OR entropy_delta >= +0.35 sustained for 2 windows. action on breach = immediate traffic switch to fp16 model + open rollback PR + capture sample batch. We should also raise severity so SRE sees it.
Anika: @deploy-bot starting canary now: 2.3-int8 -> 5% on staging. will stream logs to /canaries/2.3-int8/1718129000.
deploy-bot: Canary started by Anika at 1718129000. Monitoring hooks enabled (latency, errors, custom SLIs).
Miguel: small data point: last human eval correlated better with embedding-cosine threshold 0.10 (not 0.12). recommend we use 0.10 for semantic sim gate, keep entropy and rouge gates too. Also please log sample ids for every flagged request for audit.
Samir: +1 for 0.10. also add rate-limited sample capture: capture up to 100 flagged samples per hour per slice to avoid storage blowup.
Anika: updating canary config to include: 1) contracts_rouge_delta <= -5% OR entropy_delta >= +0.35 OR embed_cosine_delta <= -0.10, 2) sustain for 2x15min windows, 3) fallback route -> fp16, 4) capture 100/hr per-slice. pushing config now.
Anika: config snippet I'm applying:
```yaml
canary_id: 2.3-int8-1718129000
traffic: 5%
gates:
  - name: contracts_quality_gate
    metrics:
      - name: contracts_rouge_l_delta
        threshold: -0.05
      - name: token_entropy_delta
        threshold: 0.35
      - name: embed_cosine_delta
        threshold: -0.10
    sustain_windows: 2
    window_length_minutes: 15
    on_breach: fallback_to_fp16
sample_capture:
  enabled: true
  max_per_hour_per_slice: 100
```
Rebecca: please also add a nightly synthetic harness run for the contracts slice that compares fp16 vs int8 and posts a short diff to the canary channel. automate human-eval kick if the diff > 4% on that slice.
Anika: added the nightly job and human-eval trigger. will monitor the first 2 hours and report back.
Miguel: if fallback happens, let's keep a pinned thread with top 20 flagged sample ids + short human notes. makes debug much faster.
Samir: one operational note — set alert noise controls: only escalate to paging if both contracts_rouge and entropy breach at same time. otherwise page to oncall but as low urgency.
Anika: agreed. thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the updated rollout doc and the PR link once the config lands. monitoring now.
